units.source_text: 很可能我刚开始决斗的时候，那个女人就跑掉了。

en.t: Most likely, that woman ran away just as I began the duel.

units.source_text: ——想到这种可能，我为了保命，就拿了大刀和弓箭，折返原路。

en.t: Thinking that might have happened, I took the long sword and the bow and arrows to save my own life, and went back the way I had come.

units.source_text: 女人的马在路边安静的吃草。

en.t: The woman's horse was quietly grazing by the roadside.

units.source_text: 之后的事情就不用再提了。

en.t: There is no need to speak any further about what happened after that.

units.source_text: 至于大刀，进京之前我早就卖掉了。

en.t: As for the long sword, I had already sold it before entering the capital.
That is all of my testimony.
Everyone must die sooner or later, so go ahead and kill me.
With an air of righteous defiance.
